checks.name: binding is lazy and non-mirror resources are unchanged
fixed plane is rebased without changing world vertices
stable selection and host token / 30Hz budget
hidden, behind-camera and off-frustum owners have no target
all reflection surfaces are hidden and callbacks stay inert during prepass
unknown renderer exception restores public state and requires renderer rebuild
shader diagnostic rejects only after render returned and releases candidate
context loss before render does not claim a fresh pass
candidate preflight preserves old owner target and separates counters
failed candidate preflight leaves old target alive
target/material/geometry disposal is once and reactivation allocates fresh
invalid mirror binding rejects without allocating a target
all owned reflection target objects released

limits: CPU uses the actual locked Three Reflector with a renderer substitute. No WebGL pixels, shader compilation, private-render-stack recovery, browser close/reopen or ordinary-computer performance was verified.
Preflight is a separately counted transaction validation phase. Target counters describe target objects and dispose events, not GPU bytes.
